> **Before filing, please read:**
>
> Websites change their structure frequently, which can break scrapers. If
> you're reporting a scraper failure, it's likely already known and being
> addressed. Automated `wmdl discover` runs every Wednesday at 05:00, and
> I aim to fix any scraper issues before the following Wednesday's run.
>
> To reduce noise, please wait until the issue has persisted for **two
> consecutive Wednesday runs** after the latest release or commit before filing
> a report. If a fix was pushed in between those runs, give it a chance to
> prove itself.
